name: WF-11 Product Service v2 - WooCommerce Source of Truth

parameters.jsCode:
const r=$json;
if(r.error || r.success===false) throw new Error(r.error_message || 'WooCommerce product read failed');
const p=r.product || r.data || r;
const clean={
  id:p.id ?? null,
  name:p.name ?? null,
  sku:p.sku ?? null,
  type:p.type ?? null,
  status:p.status ?? null,
  price:p.price ?? null,
  regular_price:p.regular_price ?? null,
  sale_price:p.sale_price ?? null,
  on_sale:p.on_sale ?? false,
  purchasable:p.purchasable ?? false,
  manage_stock:p.manage_stock ?? false,
  stock_quantity:p.stock_quantity ?? null,
  stock_status:p.stock_status ?? null,
  backorders_allowed:p.backorders_allowed ?? false,
  parent_id:p.parent_id ?? 0,
  attributes:p.attributes ?? [],
  variations:Array.isArray(p.variations)?p.variations:[],
  categories:Array.isArray(p.categories)?p.categories.map(c=>({id:c.id,name:c.name,slug:c.slug})):[],
  images:Array.isArray(p.images)?p.images.map(i=>({id:i.id,src:i.src,alt:i.alt})):[],
  permalink:p.permalink ?? null
};
const available = clean.purchasable === true &&
  clean.stock_status === 'instock' &&
  (clean.manage_stock !== true || clean.stock_quantity === null || Number(clean.stock_quantity) > 0);
return [{json:{
  success:true,
  request_id:$node['Validate Request'].json.request_id,
  operation:$node['Validate Request'].json.operation,
  product:clean,
  availability:{available,stock_status:clean.stock_status,stock_quantity:clean.stock_quantity},
  source:'woocommerce',
  verified_at:new Date().toISOString()
}}];
